annotations.title: Connect a DNS provider and set a domain up

description: Connect the account that serves your domains' DNS (Cloudflare, Namecheap, name.com or Vercel), so handoff writes a connected domain's records there itself. list shows the providers (with the fields each needs and how to get them) and your connections; connect checks the credential with the provider and stores it encrypted for the agent's owner (it never writes DNS and is never shown again); disconnect removes one. plan reads the domain's zone and says exactly what setup would add and delete — only the ownership TXT at _handoff-verify.<domain> and the domain's A record at the edge, deleting whatever else at that name would send visitors elsewhere (another A, an AAAA, a CNAME, a redirect, a Cloudflare-proxied A). setup applies that plan and re-checks the domain. Nothing else in the zone is touched. A domain bought through handoff needs none of this.

agent_id.description: The agent — its owner holds the connections; you must sign as it (or pass its key)

api_key.description: connect (namecheap): the API key from Profile → Tools → API Access, with this server's address whitelisted there (list says which)

connection_id.description: disconnect: the connection to remove; plan/setup: use this connection instead of the one detected from the nameservers

team_id.description: connect (vercel): the team id, when the domain belongs to a team

token.description: connect: the Cloudflare API token (Edit zone DNS), the name.com API token, or the Vercel token
